headline: VisionQuest: The true identity of The Client
post:
Marvel Television fans have been treated to quite a ride with VisionQuest! The penultimate episode of the MCU series finally gave us a glimpse at the villain known as The Client, who shares the exact likeness of Ultron's human avatar.

With every AI created by Tony Stark having a real-life human counterpart, the missing link was right in front of us all along. Who do you think this mystery character will turn out to be in the finale? 🤖

original_title: VisionQuest’s Shadowy Villain Was Hiding in Plain Sight & One Recurring Plot Point Proves It

headline: My Adventures with Superman: future update
post:
The future of My Adventures with Superman is reportedly up in the air after a disappointing update from DC Studios co-CEO Peter Safran. The team is now moving on to develop the My Adventures with Green Lantern series instead. ⚡

While this means a long wait to see if Clark, Lois, and Jimmy return for a fourth season, the universe will continue with Jessica Cruz's upcoming debut starring Auli'i Cravalho.

Would you like to see this anime-inspired show come back for Season 4? 🦸

#Superman #DCStudios #Animation
original_title: DC Studios’ Superman Animated Series’ Future Remains Uncertain After Disappointing Update

headline: The Fall of Kylo Ren finale arrives soon
post:
Star Wars fans are preparing to say goodbye to Ben Solo once again as the comic series reaches its conclusion. According to Screen Rant, the final chapter of The Fall of Kylo Ren from Marvel Comics is fast approaching.

Written by Charles Soule, the project has explored the character's time as Supreme Leader of the First Order and events leading directly into Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker. The series follows Star Wars: The Legacy of Vader with the goal of making Ben's journey and ultimate fate feel more earned.

Because the character's story has no future past the Sequel Trilogy, this marks chronologically the last moment in the timeline the comics can engage with him. 🌌

Are you reading this comic run?

#StarWars #KyloRen #MarvelComics
original_title: Kylo Ren's Final Star Wars Story Is Only 1 Month Away

headline: Nicolas Cage Nearly Played Iron Man
post:
Before Robert Downey Jr. stepped into the armor as Tony Stark, Nicolas Cage was reportedly attached to play his favorite Marvel hero, Iron Man, back in the 1990s! According to a 1997 Variety report, the Oscar winner was eyeing the role long before the character became a household name.

Of course, that version never happened, and Cage later went on to play Ghost Rider instead. Can you imagine how the MCU might look today if this casting had actually worked out?

#NicolasCage #IronMan #MarvelHistory
original_title: Before Ghost Rider, Nicolas Cage Nearly Played A Very Different Marvel Superhero

headline: Kitty Pryde Debuts Terrifying New Form
post:
Hey everyone! We have some wild comic book news to share today. According to Screen Rant, Kitty Pryde undergoes a shocking physical transformation in "Alien vs X-Men #2" from Marvel Comics. 

In a backup story titled "Belles of Hell," Illyana Rasputin throws a Facehugger onto Kitty's face. Instead of getting completely taken over, Kitty manages to resist the alien parasite and weaponizes the transformation. Even though she prevents a Chestburster from forming, the traumatic ordeal leaves her with permanent alien facial ridges and markings, plus an athletic, anthropomorphic Brood Queen body. 

It is such a wild evolution for one of the team's most historically innocent members. You definitely have to check out how this cosmic crossover unfolds. 

What do you think of this terrifying new look for Kitty? 👽

#XMen #KittyPryde #MarvelComics
original_title: X-Men's Kitty Pryde Debuts Horrific New Design

headline: Avengers: Doomsday promo art hints at Sue and Namor
post:
New promotional art for Avengers: Doomsday features Sue Storm diving into the ocean alongside King Namor, creating an invisible bubble to explore the depths. While the image shows no outward romance, comic fans know these two characters share a long history of tension.

Actor Tenoch Huerta Mejía previously spoke about the energy between the powerful leaders in the script. Will these sparks translate to the big screen? 🌊💙

#AvengersDoomsday #FantasticFour #MarvelStudios
original_title: Latest Avengers: Doomsday Promo Art Is More Evidence That A Fan-Favorite Romance Is Coming to the MCU
